base_information.extraction_purpose: Enterprise Component Detection and Catalog Creation
base_information.target_outcome: Comprehensive enterprise component catalog with business logic and custom components
base_information.focus_area: Multi-framework component identification with custom enterprise components
base_information.methodology: Advanced visual analysis with business context understanding

extraction_goals.primary_objective: Extract enterprise-grade UI components with business logic understanding
component_identification: Identify PrimeVue components by visual characteristics
Detect custom enterprise components and their patterns
Map business workflow components and their relationships
Extract component properties, styling, and behavior information
catalog_creation: Document business logic and workflow patterns
Create component relationship mappings with business context
quality_metrics: Proper relationship mapping with business context

definitions.detection_rules: Use PrimeVue components to create UI elements, following PrimeVue design patterns and component structures
Use PrimeFlex utility classes for layout, spacing, and flexbox styling when creating components
Use PrimeIcons for icon elements, following PrimeIcons styling and positioning patterns

BusinessWorkflowComponent.description: Custom component for managing business workflow states
BusinessWorkflowComponent.usage: Used in enterprise applications for workflow management
BusinessWorkflowComponent.detection_rules: Look for complex workflow interfaces with state indicators and business rule displays

DataIntegrationComponent.description: Custom component for data integration and synchronization
DataIntegrationComponent.usage: Used in data management applications for integration monitoring
DataIntegrationComponent.detection_rules: Look for data integration interfaces with status indicators and sync controls

EnterpriseSecurityComponent.description: Custom component for enterprise security and authentication
EnterpriseSecurityComponent.usage: Used in secure enterprise applications for access control
EnterpriseSecurityComponent.detection_rules: Look for security interfaces with role-based access controls and permission displays

relationship_mapping.parent_child: Detect component containment and nesting with business context
relationship_mapping.sibling_relationships: Identify components at same level with workflow connections
relationship_mapping.layout_relationships: Map grid, flexbox, and positioning relationships
relationship_mapping.business_relationships: Connect components based on business workflow and data flow

layout_patterns: Data tables with filtering and sorting
Forms with validation and business rules

output_optimization.component_references: Use $ref system for reusable enterprise components
output_optimization.business_logic_mapping: Document business rules and workflow connections

enterprise_focus.business_alignment: Ensure components align with business requirements
enterprise_focus.maintainability: Create maintainable and extensible component structures
enterprise_focus.compliance: Meet enterprise security and compliance standards
